subject: design/skill-command-prefix-v1
statement: Matching is **ALT-3 structural forms** on all live surfaces outside the system tree, plus **exhaustive skill-basename references under the live system tree** (paths and content). Outside the system tree, do not bare-English whole-token replace. Frozen merged documents are never rewritten for historical command strings (NG-2).
